mapper.select: SELECT id, question_id, input_path, output_path, input_size, output_size, case_num, score_weight, is_sample, created_at FROM `test_case` WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY case_num ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM `test_case` WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND is_sample = 1 ORDER BY case_num ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM `test_case` WHERE input_path IS NULL OR input_path = '' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_sample = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sampleCount, COALESCE(SUM(input_size), 0) AS totalInputBytes, COALESCE(SUM(output_size), 0) AS totalOutputBytes, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(input_size, 0) + COALESCE(output_size, 0)), 0) AS totalBytes FROM `test_case` WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `test_case` (question_id, input_path, output_path, input_size, output_size, case_num, score_weight, input, expected_output, is_sample) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{inputPath}, #{outputPath}, #{inputSize}, #{outputSize}, #{caseNum}, #{scoreWeight}, #{input}, #{expectedOutput}, #{isSample})

INSERT INTO `test_case` (question_id, input_path, output_path, input_size, output_size, case_num, score_weight, input, expected_output, is_sample) VALUES
(#{item.questionId}, #{item.inputPath}, #{item.outputPath}, #{item.inputSize}, #{item.outputSize}, #{item.caseNum}, #{item.scoreWeight}, #{item.input}, #{item.expectedOutput}, #{item.isSample})
